title: The Lost Library Key
synopsis: But the Reading Room is locked.
The big brass key is gone!
goal: Find out who has the key.

options.label: On the front desk
options.feedback: Read the note again. Is the desk by the window?

options.label: On the blue shelf by the window
In the Reading Room door
options.feedback: The door is locked. The key is not in it.

notes: Letter: Ms. Rosa's note. "I put the key on the blue shelf by the window. It was 9:00."
Question: Where did Ms. Rosa put the key?

learning.objective: 쪽지의 "on the blue shelf by the window"를 읽고 열쇠를 둔 곳을 고른다.
expressions: I put the key on the blue shelf by the window.

play.title: Ms. Rosa's Note
story: "I wrote a note this morning," she says. "Can you read it?"
play.letter:
I put the key on the blue shelf by the window. It was 9:00.
— Ms. Rosa
play.question: Where did Ms. Rosa put the key?
hints: Read the note again. Find the colour word.
Which place in the library is near the glass you look through?
play.successMessage: You found where the key was!
transition: The key was on the blue shelf at 9:00.
But now it is not there!
Ms. Rosa opens the visitor book. Who came after 9:00?

clue.title: The Key's Shelf
clue.note: Ms. Rosa put the key on the blue shelf by the window at 9:00.

evidence.name: Ms. Rosa's Note
evidence.description: A note from the front desk.
evidence.inscription: I put the key on the blue shelf by the window. It was 9:00.

notes: Letter: the visitor book. Tom came at 9:10. He read by the door. Mr. Bell came at 9:20. He had a ladder. Mrs. Lee came at 9:40. She sat at the desk.
Question: Put the visitors in order. Who came first?

clueInputs.note: The key was put on the shelf at 9:00: everyone in the book came after it.

learning.objective: 방문 기록의 시각(9:10, 9:20, 9:40)을 읽고 온 순서대로 놓는다.

play.title: The Visitor Book
story: Three people came to the library this morning.
Each one wrote in the visitor book.
play.letter:
TOM — He came at 9:10. He read by the door.
MR. BELL — He came at 9:20. He had a ladder.
MRS. LEE — She came at 9:40. She sat at the desk.
play.question: Put the visitors in order. Who came first?
hints: Look at the times. 9:10 is before 9:20.
Start with the smallest time. End with the biggest time.
play.successMessage: You put the visitors in order!
transition: Mr. Bell came at 9:20. He had a ladder.
Why did he need a ladder in a library?
You go to the blue shelf to look.
play.orderFeedback: Read the times again. Who came first? Who came last?

clue.title: The Ladder
clue.note: Mr. Bell came at 9:20. He had a ladder.

evidence.name: The Visitor Book
evidence.description: Every visitor wrote a name and a time.

notes: Letter: a job card under the blue shelf. "Mr. Bell: please fix the P-M-A-L in the Reading Room before ten." The letters are mixed up.
Question: What must Mr. Bell fix? Put the letters in the right order.

clueInputs.note: Mr. Bell came with a ladder: the card says why.

learning.objective: 섞인 글자 P-M-A-L을 바로 놓아 lamp라는 단어를 쓴다.

play.title: The Job Card
story: The blue shelf is by the window.
There is no key on it.
But under the shelf, you find a small card.
play.letter:
Mr. Bell: Please fix the P-M-A-L in the Reading Room before ten.
The letters are mixed up!
play.question: What must Mr. Bell fix? Put the letters in the right order.
hints: It gives light when a room is dark.
play.successMessage: Mr. Bell had a job to do!
transition: The job is in the Reading Room.
But the Reading Room is locked.
Who needed the key to get in?

feedback.PALM: A palm is a tree! You can't fix a tree. Try another word.

play.orderFeedback: Those are the right letters. Try another order.

clue.title: The Job
clue.note: Mr. Bell had a job in the Reading Room: fix the lamp before ten.

evidence.name: The Job Card
evidence.description: A small card from under the blue shelf.
evidence.inscription: Mr. Bell: Please fix the lamp. It is in the Reading Room.

notes: Question: The key was on the shelf at 9:00. Who came with a ladder, and had a job in the Reading Room? Spell the name to open the lock.
No lock box art (lockBoxes is optional): the plain LetterLockQuestion.

clueInputs.note: The key was on the shelf from 9:00.
Mr. Bell came at 9:20 with a ladder.
His job was the lamp in the Reading Room: he needed the key.

learning.objective: 세 단서(9:00 열쇠, 9:20 사다리, 램프 수리)를 이어 열쇠를 가져간 사람을 찾고 이름을 쓴다.
expressions: Who had a job in the Reading Room?

play.title: The Locked Door
story: You stand at the Reading Room door.
A little light comes from under it.
The door has a letter lock.
play.letter:
9:00 — The key is on the blue shelf.
9:20 — A visitor comes with a ladder.
The job card — Fix the lamp in the Reading Room.
play.question: Who had a job in the Reading Room? Spell the name to open the lock.
hints: Look at your notebook. Who came with a ladder?
The job card names the person. Use those letters.
transition: Mr. Bell is on his ladder. The lamp is bright!
"Sorry, Ms. Rosa," he says. "I borrowed the key to fix the lamp."
He gives the big brass key back.
It is ten o'clock. Story hour can start!
play.orderFeedback: Right letters, wrong order. Whose name is it?

evidence.name: The Brass Key
evidence.description: The big key of the Reading Room. It was borrowed, not stolen.

hook: The lamp is on. Story hour can start!

learningGoal.title: Where and when: by, on, at

objectives: Find out who has the key.
intro: But the Reading Room is locked.
The big brass key is gone!
play.caseSummary: Mr. Bell did not steal the key. He borrowed it to fix the lamp, and story hour started on time.
